curated.title: Weaving Carpet at Lachen
curated.creator: Jirah P Lepcha
curated.summary: This video is captured in Lachen. A Lachenpa women in north Sikkim is working to prepare a carpet. She is using the scissor to cut down the excess wool and to give the shape to the motifs. The Lachenpa women weave their carpets at their home or at the government handloom and handicraft centre. Each motif carries the meaning related to their religion and life.
